entry: Settings > Other > Sounds & Haptics; searchable by Sound or Haptics
changes: Independent app-wide haptic and interface sound switches with a preview action.
Retain existing browser.swipe.haptics and browser.swipe.sound keys, defaults, iCloud scope, and backup compatibility.
Route 45 direct UIKit feedback calls and the compatible SwiftUI success modifier through the shared live preference gate.
Gate gesture sounds and extension notification sounds without changing webpage or media playback audio.
Replace gesture-only controls with a link to the same settings page.
Use a separate sheet for the nested gesture-page entry on iOS 16 to avoid a reproduced NavigationStack invalidation loop.
Add two translated strings to all 50 locales.

validation.native_feedback_audit: No direct native feedback generators, sensoryFeedback modifiers, or interface sound playback calls remain outside the shared player in app-owned source.
validation.localization: check_localization.py --strict passed for all 50 locales; all ReadingTools.strings passed plutil -lint
validation.metadata: export_metadata_json.py --check passed; release metadata and version unchanged

diagnostics: The initial backup regression run inherited a numeric wallpaper launch argument as a string. Removing that test manifest override allowed the unchanged backup test to pass.
The first iOS 16 UI run reproduced the nested navigation loop and was cancelled; the final run passed after the legacy sheet fix.

principles: Category links replace expanded root-level controls
Keep search shortcuts to individual settings
Keep common settings within two levels

limits: Physical haptic sensation and device silent-mode behavior were not tested on hardware.
